facts.fact: Kenya's Civil Registration Services say interoperability between CRVS and National ID systems is established: parents' national ID details are in birth records and the Birth Entry Number is in National ID registration, with birth records used to verify identity at ID registration.

KEN.note: The document gives no count or share of people holding a national ID.

facts.fact: Kenya's Civil Registration Services list as next step the adoption of a Unique Personal Identifier, a lifelong identifier assigned at birth.

KEN.note: The document says nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
The document names no public register keyed on the ID number.
The document describes the link with National ID registration but not the ID system's issuing, biometrics or assurance.
